result.title: Open-OmniCoach: Evidence-Enhanced Trajectory Learning for Omni Video Agents
result.comment: 24 pages. Project Page: https://open-omnicoach.github.io , Code: https://github.com/Open-OmniCoach/omnicoach , Models & Data: https://huggingface.co/Open-OmniCoach
result.summary: Training capable omni video agents requires more than diverse question-answer pairs: agents must learn to reliably find, connect, and correct task-relevant evidence in omni-setting. However, we argue that existing data pipelines provide limited control over task-relevant evidence and weak supervision for these capabilities. In this work, we present Open OmniCoach, a new framework for evidence-seeking omni video agents. It contains a high-quality dataset, OmniCoach-240K, and a new agentic reinforcement learning (RL) method, Step-Level Evidence-Guided Policy Optimization (SEPO). For the former, OmniCoach-240K comprises 248.2K interaction trajectories, including 230.7K multi-span trajectories and 17.4K reflection trajectories. We design a three-stage data pipeline by leveraging both fine-grained omni-evidence and the agent's own errors. Meanwhile, compared with other RL baselines, SEPO provides turn-level credit based on improvements in evidence coverage and temporal localization. Applying both trajectory data and the SEPO method, we obtain Open OmniAgent models. The resulting models outperform the baselines across multiple video and audio-visual understanding tasks by significant margins, demonstrating the effectiveness of the Open OmniCoach framework. In particular, Open OmniAgent-30B improves average accuracy over Qwen3-Omni by 6.3 percentage points across nine benchmarks, with gains of 12.2 and 13.3 points on LVOmniBench and LVBench, respectively.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Open-OmniCoach 框架：构建含 24.8 万条多跨度与反思交互轨迹的全模态视频数据集 OmniCoach-240K，并提出按证据覆盖提升与时间定位改进分配轮级信用的 agentic RL 方法 SEPO，训练出 Open OmniAgent 模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 多跨度证据搜索、基于自身错误的反思路径与轮级信用分配，与 LVR 关注的证据筛选、THINK/LOOK/STOP 决策及贡献分配直接相关；待核查其状态是显式交互轨迹而非 latent 推理状态，且以视频问答准确率作为主要评价。
